name: design-system
description: Generated authority/DS-author Claude Code convenience adapter for canonical skills and hook feedback. Its hooks no-op outside an exact DS-author target, and the plugin must only be assigned to authority-only endpoints because plugin skills and commands are provider-discovered. Product governance comes from the immutable @qijenchen/design-system snapshot and protected hard gates; this plugin is not a policy source of truth.

_metadata.structure_note: Plugin discovery aliases are deterministic generated views. Their alias paths, provider-owned destination keys, and required entries are declared only in packages/governance/canonical/plugin-aliases.json; exact targets are resolved from providers.json and checked by the governance build graph.
_metadata.authority_note: This full-corpus plugin is scoped to repository role authority / governance role ds-author. Managed deployment must prove authority-only endpoint assignment with mixed-role use disabled; the generated hook launchers additionally verify the target before transcript processing. The hook guard is defense in depth and does not hide provider-discovered plugin skills or commands on an incorrectly assigned endpoint. Claude Code does not load a plugin-root CLAUDE.md as project context. A governed product must instead receive AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, product-role provider adapters, the immutable lock, and the hook-independent checker from the authenticated package snapshot.
migration_done: skill and command discovery aliases generated from the canonical plugin alias registry
hooks/hooks.json generated from .claude/settings.json hooks section + ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} path rewrite
hook script discovery alias generated from the same registry and provider-owned tree
intentional_omissions: .claude/rules/ — project policy is delivered by the immutable consumer snapshot; plugin installation alone does not load project instructions or rules.
.claude/references/ — canonical references stay in the authenticated package/snapshot and are reached through project instructions or an invoked skill, not through plugin-root CLAUDE.md.
.claude/memory/ — by design 不 distribute(memory 是 user-specific / session-specific,跨 user 不該 sync)。
